Yes ofc i updated it. And yeah i mean trying to add it to metamask 1. Okay, could you try running `docker inspect lighthouse_beacon` and have a look if any of the cli params look sus? Alternative explanation, mac has some issues with docker `host` networking, so if you know how to modify the compose files - try switching to `bridge` networking with port maps? (i can help if you aren't sure how)(alternatively test on a linux machine) 2. Did you use `1337402` as the chainID? I'll be working on `merge-devnet-2` today, it will be based on the same spec version as `merge-devnet-1`. In case any client team has a change in the branch i should use/container image/cli flags, please do let me know. I'll add info on updated tooling, etc later today. Afaik - the aim of the devnet hasn't changed since last week. If there is some specific condition you wish to test please do let me know. If there's interest in following the chain through the merge transition, I can *try* to set the TTD super high(so it happens sometime tomorrow) and share configs beforehand to allow others to join in - if not, I'll just set it low and let people join in post merge. <@!360491619402776577> has there been a fix for the two miners at TTD issue we faced in `merge-devnet-0`? If so, do we want to test that again? No, no fix yet cool, treating it with gloves then 😄 I will try doing that when i get home, im at work atm. Mind if i DM u with questions? Ill try to bother you in minimum possible ways 😀 sure, no problem 🙂 `merge-devnet-2` is up and running! Its based on the same specs as last week, so NOT the specs that were announced just now. Configs: https://github.com/eth2-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/merge-devnet-2 beacon explorer: https://beaconchain.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ execution explorer: https://explorer.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ faucet: https://faucet.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ forkmon: https://forkmon.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ TTD hasn't been hit yet, we're about ~20% there. Merge epoch is has almost been hit. For the testers in the house, I've updated the quick-run scripts (listed under Docker instructions in Marius's testing doc) - you just have to specify the `--env-file=merge-devnet-2.vars` while running docker-compose and you'd join `merge-devnet-2`. I'm getting this error every few slots: `error: Failed to update eth1 block cache: "FailedToInsertEth1Block(InconsistentTimestamp { parent: 1638298354, child: 1638298278 })", retry_millis: 60000, service: eth1_rpc` Started around slot 857. Is that to be expected? which client combo and devnet are you trying to sync? `merge-devnet-2` crossed TTD, we're in PoS waters now no chaos so far geth (fix-optimistic-sync) and lighthouse (kintsugi). In this case I assume it's a problem with my setup. Transition worked fine here as well ah can you try geth (beacon-ontopof-... something) branch? I made a pull request but if anyone wants a simple script to start your node, here it is (only for macOS): I've added scripts for starting geth and teku on merge-devnet-2 at https://github.com/ajsutton/merge-scripts (merge-devnet-2 directory). It will automatically checkout and build geth and teku on the first run.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
1. Did you make sure to update the `merge-devnet-1.vars` file with your public IP?
2. What do you mean by adding the localhost? Did you try adding it to metamask or to something else?

excerpts.author: alexeirox
excerpts.content: Yes ofc i updated it. And yeah i mean trying to add it to metamask

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
1. Okay, could you try running `docker inspect lighthouse_beacon` and have a look if any of the cli params look sus? Alternative explanation, mac has some issues with docker `host` networking, so if you know how to modify the compose files - try switching to `bridge` networking with port maps? (i can help if you aren't sure how)(alternatively test on a linux machine)
2. Did you use `1337402` as the chainID?

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
I'll be working on `merge-devnet-2` today, it will be based on the same spec version as `merge-devnet-1`.

In case any client team has a change in the branch i should use/container image/cli flags, please do let me know. I'll add info on updated tooling, etc later today. 

Afaik - the aim of the devnet hasn't changed since last week. If there is some specific condition you wish to test please do let me know. If there's interest in following the chain through the merge transition, I can *try* to set the TTD super high(so it happens sometime tomorrow) and share configs beforehand to allow others to join in - if not, I'll just set it low and let people join in post merge. 

<@!360491619402776577> has there been a fix for the two miners at TTD issue we faced in `merge-devnet-0`? If so, do we want to test that again?
